title: Branch-Local Context Checkpoint
description: Read-only, scope-restricted report of the project context a single work package invalidated on a feature branch. Distinct from the canonical refresh manifest: a checkpoint is never promoted to canonical state and is never recorded in the refresh operation ledger. Named context-checkpoint to avoid collision with checkpoint.schema.json, which is the autopilot-roadmap resume contract.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Incremented only on a breaking change.

change_id.description: OpenSpec change this checkpoint belongs to.

package_id.description: Work package the checkpoint was computed for. Matches PackageId in work-packages.schema.json.

source_revision.description: Exact revision the checkpoint was computed against.

merge_base_revision.description: Merge base against the integration branch, used as the architecture diff baseline. Absent when no merge base could be resolved.

namespace.description: Semantic index namespace. Constrained to non-canonical values so a checkpoint cannot reach the canonical promotion path, which is gated on kind=main and key=main.

kind.description: Never 'main'. A checkpoint is structurally barred from the canonical namespace.

key.description: Namespace key identifying the change and package, joined with the '--' separator used for worktree branch names.

scope.description: The package's permitted read scope as supplied to the checkpoint. Resolved read_allow minus deny, with deny taking precedence.

context_impact.description: The ri-08 context-impact evaluation that triggered this checkpoint.

status.description: A package with no context_impact block is 'unmigrated' and is never reported as impact-free. Failing statuses (undeclared, spurious_rationale) cannot appear: they block before a checkpoint runs.

surfaces.description: Affected context surfaces. An empty array is an explicit assertion of no impact and is distinct from status 'unmigrated'.

producer_results.description: Deterministic producer findings, all computed in check mode. Sorted by producer_id for byte stability.

architecture.description: Architecture freshness and delta reported as distinct findings. A delta computed from a stale artifact is not authoritative.

freshness.description: Provenance-based freshness of the branch's architecture artifact for source_revision. Never mtime-based.

delta_authoritative.description: False whenever freshness is not 'fresh'. A non-authoritative delta must not be presented as the branch's true architecture impact.

changed_nodes.description: Architecture nodes differing from the merge-base graph. Sorted for byte stability.

semantic_index.description: Index outcome for the work-package namespace. A degraded or unconfigured index never fails the checkpoint.

checkpoint_status.description: Terminal state. 'failed' is deliberately absent: a checkpoint that cannot produce a valid report writes no report at all. Drift is data, not failure — gating is the drift-gate capability's responsibility.
